  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4119865917",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Parse count and skip with self.Arg to avoid duplicating default values and manually rejecting negative values",
      "quote": "The default values are hard-coded a second time manually / The values are parsed as a singed int, but negative values are rejected manually / I'd say all of this can be avoided by using `self.Arg<uint32_t>(\"count\")`. etc (or u64)",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author parsed via self.Arg",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4120036331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4120036331",
      "status_by_quote": "count and skip now go through self.Arg"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4119865917",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Check AdditionOverflow<u64>(count, from) and exit early to avoid manual casting later",
      "quote": "Possibly there could be an early check for `AdditionOverflow<u64>(count,from)` and early exit, to avoid having to manually cast later on?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that an early exit would return the wrong answer for valid queries",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4120036331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4120036331",
      "status_by_quote": "something like count=UINT64_MAX, skip=1 is a valid \"everything but the newest\" request, so returning early would give the wrong answer there"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4123144899",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Use uint32_t instead of uint64_t for count and skip",
      "quote": "The max was i32::max previously, it seems odd to raise it to u64, when u32 should be enough and also avoid the cast further down below?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "switched both parameters to uint32_t",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4124657107"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4124657107",
      "status_by_quote": "switched both to `uint32_t`"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
